description:
**About SKS Cleantech (Arkah Energy)**

**SKS Cleantech Private Limited (Arkah Energy) is a Mumbai-based rooftop solar company offering CAPEX EPC, OPEX/RESCO (PPA) and O&M services to co-operative housing societies and commercial and industrial clients across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and pan-India.**

**About the Role**

**We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own the housing-society market across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region: find societies, get meetings with their managing committees, explain rooftop solar and our techno-commercial differentiators, and take opportunities through to committee approval and contract. This is an individual contributor role with a mix of field work and occasional office days.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Society prospecting and lead generation**

* Build and maintain a target list of housing societies across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane and the wider MMR, prioritised by terrace area, sanctioned load, monthly common-area electricity bill and building height.
* Approach societies through secretary, chairman and treasurer contacts, society managers, federations, referrals from existing customers and cold outreach.
* Run on-ground activity: society visits, notice-board and AGM/SGM-linked outreach, and awareness sessions where permitted.
* Track every lead in the CRM from first contact to handover.

**Meeting setup and committee engagement**

* Book and conduct introductory meetings, site visits and managing committee presentations.
* Identify the real decision makers (chairman, secretary, treasurer, committee members, influential residents) and manage the sequence of conversations needed to reach a committee resolution.
* Support the society through its internal process: draft resolution points, an AGM/SGM agenda note, and answers to resident queries.

**Explaining solar and our techno-commercial USP**

* Explain rooftop solar in plain language to non-technical committee members: net metering, savings on common-area bills, discom billing impact (MSEDCL, Adani, Tata, BEST), terrace usage, safety and maintenance.
* Present our commercial models clearly and compare them honestly: CAPEX (society invests) versus RESCO/PPA (zero investment, pay per unit), including tariff, escalation, tenure and ownership terms.
* Articulate our differentiators, led by our in-house technology stack that enables faster, data-backed and transparent proposals.
* Handle objections on terrace leakage, structural load, waterproofing, society funds, resident approval, vendor lock-in and project risk, with facts and reference projects.

**Proposal and closure support**

* Collect inputs (latest electricity bills, terrace photos, society details) and coordinate with the technical team for the site survey, design and proposal.
* Walk the committee through the proposal and financials; follow up through negotiation, clarifications and the committee/general body approval.

Kling, Veo, Midjourney, Flux and whatever releases next week.

* 3–5 years in VFX, animation, post-production or AI content creation.

title: CCTV  TECHNICIANS
description:
CCTV & Network Engineer (ELV / Field Service)
  
D'VIBE PVT LTD • Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
About the job
  
We are looking for a CCTV and Networking Engineer to take ownership of surveillance and ELV installations from site survey through commissioning and long-term support. You will handle IP network integration, run preventive and corrective maintenance, and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep systems reliable and SLAs met.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Installation & Commissioning
  
• Conduct site surveys and recommend camera placement, cabling routes, and network design.
  
• Install, configure, and commission IP/analog cameras, NVRs/DVRs, VMS, and PoE switches.
  
• Supervise cabling (CAT6/fibre), termination, labelling, and testing.
  
• Complete installations to drawings and BOQ, and prepare as-built documentation.
  
  
2. Network Integration & Configuration
  
• Configure IP addressing, VLANs, routing, and basic switching for surveillance networks.
  
• Integrate CCTV with access control, fire alarm, intercom, and other ELV systems as required.
  
• Set up remote viewing, port forwarding/VPN, and mobile/VMS client access.
  
• Troubleshoot bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and PoE issues.
  
  
3. Maintenance & Support
  
• Perform scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) visits and health checks.
  
• Diagnose and resolve faults on cameras, recorders, storage, switches, and cabling.
  
• Handle service tickets within SLA and maintain accurate service reports.
  
• Manage firmware updates, backups, and storage/retention checks.
  
  
4. Site Ownership & Coordination
  
• Act as the single point of contact for assigned sites.
  
• Coordinate with clients, IT teams, civil/electrical contractors, and OEM/vendor support.
  
• Manage material requirements, site stock, and RMA/warranty claims.
  
• Brief and guide junior technicians and helpers on site.
  
  
5. Documentation & Reporting
  
• Maintain IP schedules, network diagrams, asset registers, and handover documents.
  
• Submit daily/weekly progress and service reports.
  
• Obtain client sign-offs for commissioning and closure.
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
Education: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, IT, or a related field (ITI with strong experience may be considered).
  
Technical skills:
  
• Hands-on experience with IP CCTV brands (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus, Axis, Hanwha, etc.).
  
• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, NAT, and PoE.
  
• Experience with managed switches (Cisco, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, or similar).
  
• Knowledge of structured cabling (CAT6, fibre splicing/OTDR basics) and testing tools.
  
• Familiarity with VMS platforms, NVR/storage sizing, and video analytics basics.
  
• Comfortable using laptop, crimping/testing tools, and network diagnostic utilities.
  
Good to have:
  
• CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or OEM certifications.
  
• Exposure to access control, biometrics, fire alarm, o

title: SAP HCM Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Nexucon Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd is a global technology consulting firm serving clients across diverse industries. The organization provides end-to-end services in digital transformation, business consulting, IT services, and outsourcing, covering strategy, design, implementation, and ongoing support. Its teams leverage modern technologies, including artificial intelligence, cloud computing, enterprise solutions, cybersecurity, and analytics, to address complex business and technology needs effectively. This environment offers professionals the opportunity to work on impactful projects using advanced tools and methodologies.

**Role Description**
The SAP HCM Consultant role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The consultant will configure, customize, and support SAP HCM modules, including core HR, organizational management, time management, and payroll, in line with client requirements. Daily responsibilities include gathering and analyzing business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and collaborating with technical teams on system design and integration. The consultant will also participate in process improvement initiatives, advise clients on best practices in human capital management, and help ensure compliance with relevant policies and regulations.

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Capital Management and Human Capital, with hands-on experience in SAP HCM modules.
* Candidates should possess solid Human Resources (HR) and Employee Benefits knowledge, including HR processes, policies, and statutory requirements.
